title: National STEAM Carnival
description:
National STEAM Carnival is a three-day, science-based, academic initiative, strictly non-political in nature, designed for school and college-going students from Class 1 to Class 12 and Undergraduates.

Categories:

  • Pre-Primary: Play - Class 1
  • Primary: Class 2 - Class 5
  • Junior: Class 6 - Class 8
  • Secondary: Class 9 - Class 10
  • Senior: Class 11 - Class 12, Undergraduate

Registration Fee

  • All Olympiads all together: 200 BDT
  • Creativity Exhibition: 200 BDT (Each)
  • Photography: 300 BDT
  • Curiosity Zone:
    • Workshop - Free for all
    • Food stall - Varies by stall
    • Merchandise Stall - Varies by stall

Prizes

Medal | Crest | Certificates | Gifts

READ FULL EVENT DETAILS

1. STEAM Olympiad: Final round

  • Category: Primary, Junior, Secondary
  • Rules:
    • Using a calculator is prohibited.
    • It will be short questions/MCQ.
    • Participants have to bring necessary stationeries (pen, pencil, board, etc).
    • The top 3 will get crests and achievement certificates.

2. Olympiad

  • Subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, General Science, ICT, Earth Science, Math
  • Category:
    • Primary (Only for General Science Olympiad)
    • Junior (Only for General Science, Astronomy, & ICT Olympiads)
    • Secondary
    • Senior
  • Rules:
    • 20 minutes will be given to the participants for every olympiad.
    • Using a calculator is prohibited.
    • It will be short questions/MCQ.
    • Participants have to bring necessary stationeries (pen, pencil, board, etc).

3. Project Display

  • Category: Junior, Secondary, Senior
  • Rules:
    • Participants have to be in a team of 3 members (can be from different institutions).
    • Two categories: mechanical and non-mechanical.
    • Theme: Space, Astronomy, Science, Environmental Science, Scientific Business plan.
    • Projects must be submitted on the first day of the event.
    • Participants have to bring their own electrical instruments (multi-plug, laptops, etc); electricity will be provided by authorities.
    • Judgment based on the project’s beauty, explanation, and presentation.

4. Wall Magazine & Scrapbook Display

  • Category: Junior, Secondary, Senior
  • Rules:
    • Participants have to be in a team of 3 members.
    • Theme (Wall Mag): Space, Astronomy, Science, Environmental Science, Scientific Business plan.
    • Maximum size: 8x8 feet. The shape or thickness does not matter.
    • Any type of materials can be used. Must be submitted on the first day.

5. Instant Story Writing

  • Category: Junior, Secondary, Senior
  • Rules:
    • 1 hour to write any science, space, astronomy, or scientific business related story.
    • Language: Bangla or English (No mixing allowed). Maximum 300 words.

6. Art Exhibition

  • Category: Junior, Secondary, Senior
  • Rules:
    • Theme: Astronomy, Space, Technology & Science. Digital artworks are not permitted.
    • Canvas sizes (inches): 8x8, 10x8, 12x8, 12x12, 20x12, 20x20.
    • Participants must sign their artwork. Captions (Eng/Bangla) are mandatory on the back.

7. Art Competition

  • Category: Pre-Primary, Primary, Junior
  • Rules:
    • 1 hour duration. Theme is open. Both sketch and colored allowed.
    • Participants must bring their own art materials.

8. Photography Exhibition

  • Category: Open For All (Mobile & DSLR Photography)
  • Rules:
    • Pre-registration required. Must upload high-resolution driver link before event.
    • One photo per participant. Captions are mandatory.
    • All pictures will be framed and displayed. Participants can take back their framed photos.

9. Web Design & Development

  • Category: Junior, Secondary, Senior
  • Rules:
    • Must be submitted on the first day. Copied/stolen designs will be disqualified.
    • Judged on presentation, appearance, and information.

10. Craftwork

  • Category: Pre-Primary, Primary, Junior
  • Rules:
    • Must be submitted on the first day. Cannot change/take back after submitting.
    • Theme: Open. Allowed any size.
location: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET)

title: National STEAM Olympiad
description:
Join us for the National STEAM Olympiad — a premier multi-discipline competition designed to inspire young minds across Bangladesh. Compete in STEAM Olympiad, Art, and Photography segments. All registrations are individual (solo).

Venue
SOS HERMANN GMEINER COLLEGE DHAKA, Plot No. 3-B, Block-A, Section-13, Mirpur, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh
Contact

Email

Categories

Elementary — Class 1–3 Primary — Class 4–5 Junior — Class 6–8 Secondary — Class 9–10 Senior — Class 11–12+

Registration Fees

200 BDT
STEAM Olympiad
200 BDT
Art Exhibition / Competition
300 BDT
Photography

Prizes & Awards

Medals for selected & winners
Participant Certificates for all
Appreciation Certificates (Olympiad winners)
Crests for top performers

Segment Details

STEAM Olympiad — 200 BDT
All 5 categories eligible.
  • Organized in two rounds: Selection Round and Final Round.
  • Final Round will be held alongside the National STEAM Carnival.
  • Selection Round is institution-based.
  • Using a calculator is prohibited.
  • Format: Short questions / MCQ.
  • Participants must bring their own stationery (pen, pencil, board, etc.).
  • Top 100 of Selection Round receive medals and achievement certificates.
  • Top 300 of Selection Round advance to the Final Round.
Art Exhibition & Competition — 200 BDT
Art Exhibition — Junior, Secondary & Senior
  • Theme: Astronomy, Space, Technology & Science.
  • Digital artworks are not permitted.
  • Participants may submit sketch and/or colored art.
  • Canvas/paper sizes: 8×8", 10×8", 12×8", 12×12", 20×12", 20×20" (inches).
  • Any art materials are permitted.
  • Participants must sign their artwork.
  • Stolen or copied artwork will be disqualified.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bangla) — include Caption, Name, and Institution on the back of the artwork.
  • Authorities may decline artworks containing nudity, violence, or political content.
  • No changes allowed after submission.
  • Artwork must be submitted by the first day of the event. All submitted artworks will be displayed.
Art Competition Primary & Junior Only
  • Only for Primary (Class 1–5) and Junior (Class 6–8) participants.
  • Participants have 1 hour to complete their artwork.
  • Bring your own materials: color pencils, board, pencil, eraser, sharpener, etc.
  • Both sketch and colored art are accepted.
  • Theme: Open.
Photography Exhibition — 300 BDT
Mobile Photography & DSLR Photography
  • Photos must be submitted before the event — this is a pre-registration exhibition.
  • All photos will be framed and displayed at the event.
  • Submit photos in high-resolution via a downloadable drive link.
  • Each participant may submit one photo.
  • Stolen or copied photos will be disqualified.
  • Captions are mandatory (English or Bangla) — include Caption, Name, and Institution with the photo / in the registration form.
  • Authorities may decline photos containing nudity, violence, or political content.
  • No changes allowed after submission.
  • Participants may take back their framed photos after the event.
location: SOS HERMANN GMEINER COLLEGE DHAKA, Plot No. 3-B, Block-A, Section-13, Mirpur, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh
